summary: Love and values merge growth and belief. This concentrated pattern asks you to use relational grace and optimism with awareness.
body: Love and values merge growth and belief. This concentrated pattern asks you to use relational grace and optimism with awareness. Pleasure meets expansion. Gentleness, generosity, sensitivity, and a great deal of ease. These drives sit close together, so the pattern may feel natural, immediate, and hard to separate. In practice, this can show up through love and values, growth and belief, and the choices you make when approval seeking or overreach starts running the room.
gift: The gift is relational grace, optimism, and a more conscious way to work with love and values and growth and belief.
shadow: The shadow is approval seeking, overreach, and repeating the same pattern without noticing what it is trying to teach.
integration: Let love and values and growth and belief cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Likable and fortunate; the missing ingredient is discipline.
do: Name how love and values and growth and belief are both involved
Turn relational grace and optimism into one concrete choice
dont: Let approval seeking make the decision
Assume what feels natural is automatically balanced
Ignore the needs of love and values or growth and belief
